# Luxe Event Co.

> Luxe Event Co. is a Toronto event brand bringing together crafted coffee, elevated desserts, and elegant seating rentals for memorable gatherings and celebrations.

The official website is https://luxeeventco.ca. The complete website is coming soon; the current page is the official brand introduction.

## Experiences

- Luxe Coffee Bar: Refined mobile coffee experiences focused on warm pours and considered rituals.
- Luxe Sweet Cart: Elevated dessert experiences with small indulgences, beautifully staged.
- Luxe Seating Rentals: Elegant seating rentals balancing form, function, and room to gather.

## Official links

- [Luxe Event Co.](https://luxeeventco.ca): Official website.
